b.span: System Clock Domain Architecture & Signal Bus Definitions

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 1px; height: 1px; padding-top: 987px; margin-left: 68px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #334155;
display: inline-block; font-size: 15px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#334155, #acb8c9); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: nowrap;

div.div:
Clock Domains:
• ZCLK (8 MHz - 10 MHz): Primary Z80 CPU clock.
• MCLK (32 MHz - 40 MHz): 4x Master Clock for synchronous DMA.
• FPGA Internal Clock (96 MHz - 160 MHz): 3x to 4x MCLK for FPU.

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 1px; height: 1px; padding-top: 982px; margin-left: 633px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #334155;
display: inline-block; font-size: 15px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#334155, #acb8c9); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: nowrap;

div.div:
Backplane Bus Widths & Signals:
• A[15:0]: 16-bit Z80 Address Bus.
• D[7:0]: 8-bit Bidirectional Z80 Data Bus.
• C[14:0]: 15-bit Z80 Control Bus
• GPIO[15:0]: 16-bit general purpose fast interconnect.

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 1px; height: 1px; padding-top: 974px; margin-left: 1108px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #334155;
display: inline-block; font-size: 15px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#334155, #acb8c9); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: nowrap;

div.div:
Shadow Bus DMA Protocol (SD[8:0], SC[5:0]):
• SD[8:0]: 9-bit Shadow Data Bus (8-bit data + parity).
• SC[5:0]: Shadow Control.
• Transfers: Direct 40 MHz peer-to-peer burst DMA.
• Bus Termination: All lines AC terminated to eliminate line reflections.
